name: deed.page
summary: Publishes a file or folder to a permanent public deed.page URL in one call, with no account, API key, email code or claim link.
description: The repository is a plugin that bundles the deed.page agent skill with the hosted deed.page MCP server. The skill is one file, skills/deed-page/SKILL.md, and does the publish with one curl request. The MCP server runs at https://deed.page/mcp over Streamable HTTP.

Ask the agent to publish a folder to deed.page or to host a report and give you a link. It calls publish_site with the files and answers with the live URL; to change the site later it calls update_site with the same slug and token. The first publish returns an owner token once, and that token is the key to update or delete the sites it owns.
Free plan: 25 sites, 25 MB per site, 60 publishes per hour. Free sites are public, so do not publish secrets. Static files only. It is a community project, not made or endorsed by Anthropic.
notice: Sites published on the free plan are public. The plugin installs from its own repository's marketplace, not from Anthropic's.
